test_title: PYST 22: SSC CHSL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 09 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

A & B means A is the wife of B,

A / B means A is the brother of B,

A × B means A is the sister of B,

A - B means A is the father of B.

Based on the above, how is L related to K in L / M × D - K?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 &
 /
 ×
 -
 
 

 Meaning
 Wife
 Brother
 Sister
 Father
 
 

 

Given: L / M × D - K

It means: L is the Brother of M, M is the Sister of D, D is the Father of K.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bf9024005697d61a4c42cf81a1dbdfc9b5379dce70c9a0a463f85fc94b015285.png] 

So, L is the 'Father's brother' of K.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
